##### Project general facts

JW Marriott Residences Yas Island is a branded beachfront community developed by Taraf, set directly on the sand with a championship golf course running alongside. It marks the first residential address of the JW Marriott brand in the area, with residential operations and design standards delivered by Marriott International. The architecture draws on the landscape, light and heritage of the region, and the collection spans one, two and three bedroom apartments, four bedroom duplex residences and a single exclusive penthouse in each tower. Generous private balconies, elevated ceiling heights and abundant natural daylight define every home.

The amenities are designed around wellbeing, leisure and connection. Outdoors, residents enjoy a main pool, a lounge pool with sun loungers, a dedicated kids pool and play area, a paddle court, open green lawns, an outdoor fitness and yoga zone, an outdoor kitchen and dining area, a sunset deck, a fire pit with seating and direct beach access with water sports storage. Indoors, the offering includes a residents' lounge, a gym and movement studio, an indoor cinema, a games room, a golf simulator room, a kids' play room, treatment rooms, sauna and steam rooms, a co-working area, meeting rooms and guest suites.

Every residence comes with a fitted kitchen, and the larger layouts add a separate closed kitchen, a maid's room and walk-in closets, while the living spaces are left unfurnished so that owners can style them to their own taste. Layouts are arranged to maximize views from every home. Marriott International manages the residences and brings its brand standards to daily living, and ownership opens access to privileges across the Marriott portfolio.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island is the premier leisure and entertainment destination of Abu Dhabi, home to Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World, SeaWorld, Yas Waterworld, Yas Marina Circuit and Etihad Arena. The western shoreline combines natural beaches with the links-style fairways of Yas Links, creating a calm residential setting within reach of the island's headline attractions.

Daily life is well served by Yas Mall, the dining and promenade of Yas Bay Waterfront and the restaurants and yachts of Yas Marina. Schools, clinics and supermarkets are spread across the island's residential districts, and direct links to the main highways connect residents with Zayed International Airport, Saadiyat Island and the centre of Abu Dhabi.

Yas Island is one of the most sought after investment zones in the capital, where international buyers can acquire freehold property. Steady tourism, major events and a growing resident population support strong rental demand, while beachfront land on the island remains scarce and highly valued.
